tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Trade Representative shall coordinate the consideration of international trade policy issues that arise as a result of, and shall develop international trade policy as it relates to, the implementation of this subchapter.

tree.heading: Negotiating functions
tree.text: The Trade Representative has responsibility for coordinating United States discussions and negotiations with foreign countries for the purpose of establishing mutual arrangements with respect to standards-related activities. In carrying out this responsibility, the Trade Representative shall inform and consult with any Federal agency having expertise in the matters under discussion and negotiation.

tree.heading: Cross reference
tree.text: For provisions of law regarding general authority of the Trade Representative with respect to trade agreements, see section 2171 of this title.
